info.description: Pre-production waste management API. This specification documents the current contract; business operations require global authority or explicit organization membership. Decimal quantities and money are JSON strings. Posted operations are corrected through audited reversals.

get.description: ADMINISTRATOR only. Includes previously revoked membership state; missing organization, account or association returns 404.

put.description: ADMINISTRATOR only. Requires active organization/account, records changes in the audit log, and reactivates revoked memberships. MEMBER and MANAGER are organization-local roles; neither grants platform administration. Repeating the same active grant is idempotent.

delete.description: ADMINISTRATOR only. Retains the membership row and writes an audit event. Further organization reads fail immediately. Business APIs require the organization header and global authority or current membership.
